g.text: MASSAGE
hands + feet + back:
pain, sleep, calm!
BREATHING
slow in-4 out-6:
panic, pain, BP!
RELAXATION
tense-release +
imagery + music!
CONTRAINDICATIONS!
clots! fractures! skin!
cancer-site! ask!
CONSENT + CULTURE
"may I…?" gender +
faith + document!
MASSAGE (nurse-scope!): HAND (chemo nausea! anxiety!) · FOOT (sleep! labour! elders!)
· BACK/SHOULDER (tension! grief-held bodies!) · 5-15 min, shea butter, warm hands, consent.
Teach FAMILY (back rubs for labour! foot rubs for dying!) — skills that outlast shifts.
HOW: warm hands + oil/butter + slow strokes toward heart + ask pressure ("more? less?") +
breathe together + quiet + 5-min minimum. End: "rest now — I'll check soon." Document:
site + minutes + response (pain 7→4! slept!).
BREATHING: in-4, hold-2, out-6 (long OUT calms!) · panic: breathe WITH them, count aloud
· labour: slow rhythm + partner counts · pain: breath + imagery ("blow the pain away").
Teach + practise + cue cards — breaths beat pills for panic.
RELAXATION: progressive tense-RELEASE (feet→face!) · guided imagery (river! farm! beach!)
· music (gospel! highlife softly!) · prayer-meditation (faith-framed calm!). Insomnia,
hypertension, chronic pain, pre-op fear — prescribe sessions like drugs.
CONTRAINDICATIONS: DVT/clots (NEVER massage legs!) · fractures/dislocations · skin
infection/burns/open wounds · cancer SITES (ask doctor!) · bleeding disorders · first-
trimester abdomen · patient REFUSAL (always final!). Check, then touch.
CONSENT + CULTURE: "may I massage your feet…?" + gender match offered + faith respected
+ chaperone where apt + DOCUMENT consent + response. Touch heals; unconsented touch harms.
MANTRA: "warm hands, slow breath, consent first, document response."
